name: <project name, as it appears in text addressed to the user>
repo_root: <absolute path of the repository root, with forward slashes>
code_root: <root of the application code, with a trailing slash>

language.chat: <language of chat, summaries and the documents the method produces>
language.commit: <language of commit messages and changelog entries>

tech_doc: <path of the technical document, or drop this key>
changelog: <path of the log of released versions, or drop this key>

version.field: <the exact spot in that file where the version lives>

paths.studies: <folder holding the working folders, one per problem>
paths.lib_notes: <folder of the notes on a technology>
paths.review_state: <folder of the review ledger, inside the tree but outside version control>

commit.memory_prefix: <prefix of the memory and documentation commit message>

paths: <a path belonging to the area, usable as a Git pathspec>

run: <the exact line to run, not a description of it>
<the line that compiles, type-checks or lints <FILES> without writing anything>
<the line that applies only the safe lint fixes to <FILES>>
<the line that runs only the tests <FILES>>
